cat > /workspace/tmp/bench_plan.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, time, random, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *
from planning import solve
from common import validate

random.seed(3)
nreq=4096; noff=8192
leases=[{'id':'L0','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64','start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':[0],'low_count':32}]
services=[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}]
rq=[{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096}]
for i in range(64):
    rq.append({'id':'g%d'%i,'parent':'all','capacity':64})
oq=[{'id':'all','parent':None,'capacity':4096}]
for i in range(64):
    oq.append({'id':'h%d'%i,'parent':'all','capacity':64})
requests=[]
for i in range(nreq):
    requests.append({'id':'q%05d'%i,'at':10,'lease':'L0','target':'2001:db8:1:1200::%d'%(i+1),
                     'service':'web','group':'g%d'%(i%64)})
offers=[]
for j in range(noff):
    reqs=random.sample([r['id'] for r in requests],32)
    offers.append({'id':'p%05d'%j,'time':20,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/64',
                   'capacity':2,'cost':random.randint(0,10**9),'group':'h%d'%(j%64),'requests':reqs})
job=base_job(leases=leases,services=services,queries=[10],requests=requests,offers=offers,
             request_quotas=rq,offer_quotas=oq)
t=time.time(); context=validate(job); print('validate %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
active={r['id']:True for r in requests}
t=time.time(); plan=solve(context,active); print('solve %.2fs'%(time.time()-t), plan['resolved'], plan['cost'])
PYEOF
cd /workspace && timeout 900 python3 /workspace/tmp/bench_plan.py
